turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So I understand you have been experiencing some abdominal pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah yeah stomach hurt, started hurting more last couple of days, maybe 3 days ago I think.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so for three days ago, for the last three days you said it's been hurting more. Did you have pain before that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It felt weird, like crampy. I just, I just thought I was constipated, 'cause I've been haven't been able to be able to go to the bathroom as well. I just thought I was kind of bloated a bit, but yeah, about about that time, started to feel a little bit more painful.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Can you tell me kind of where you're feeling the pain the most?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, kinda like near my right hip like lower where my stomach is that kind of right and below my belly button. Sometimes a little bit on the top just below my belly button, but mainly just in that right lower side yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you ever had pain like this in the past?

turns.text: No, never.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And for the last three days, has it been pretty constant? Has it been on and off?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I feel it's been getting worse to be honest.

turns.text: Is there anything that you can think of this made it feel better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Honestly, just resting flat makes it feel a little bit better, but nothing much, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, is there anything that makes it worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Touching it. Also I puked the the other day and that made it definitely feel worse, just that whole contraction in my body was nasty.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, was it just the one time?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, you had the nausea associated with the pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Mhm, mhm.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, did the pain stay in that same spot or does it move anywhere else?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It has pretty much stayed in that one spot, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you noticed any fevers lately?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Felt a bit hot the other day, didn't take a temperature though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, OK, and what specifically prompted you to come in today to the emergency department?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I thought it was just going to get better when it first started. Maybe just a bit of gas, but here we are kind of Thursday now and it's still pretty bad.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been in contact with anyone that's been sick lately?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not off the top of my head, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you traveled anywhere recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And I forgot to ask, did you notice any changes to your bowel habits?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, yeah. Before it was fairly regular, about once a day. Five days ago, I started getting constipated, it backed up and pretty much the picture I think last time I went to the bathroom was two days ago I think, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I'm just gonna ask you some questions about your overall health. You have any chronic conditions that you see your family doctor for, or any other doctor?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I got diabetes, type 2.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And has that generally has that been well controlled for you lately?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Most part, doctor checks my sugars. I'm not too regular on them myself, but last time he changed medications was a couple years back and I've just been on the same ones ever since.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What medication are you currently taking?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Metformin? Metformin.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you ever had any surgeries in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I had my teeth pulled as a kid, but no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, still have your appendix?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, I never had that problem as a kid.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, sometimes get a little bit congested during the fall, but that's it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you have any family history of gastrointestinal problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Gas, like no. I think my grandma died of breast cancer fairly early, but no, not not that not that I can think of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and just in terms of your lifestyle, do you live here in town?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah yeah, I live here.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Living alone or with family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, I got family. Me, the wife, got two kids, one of them is college bound now but yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Nice, and what do you do for work? Or are you retired?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'm still working, I am a production overseer, production manager over at Fairbanks.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, you're a big boss.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It took awhile to get here.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I'm sure it was very hard work. In general, do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh yeah, like, well, plan on drinking on the two four but not regular, special occasions mainly. Hot days, sometimes I'll have a beer or two.

turns.text: Sure, and do you smoke cigarettes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: Any other substances?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, is there anything else you wanted to bring up today that I didn't ask you about or any other questions that you have?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, just hoping to get an answer to whatever is going on.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, well at this point I will do a quick physical exam.
